prompt: The fix directory holds 30 pages (f-01.txt through f-30.txt). Each page holds exact id, prev, and next lines naming page ids. Start at the page whose prev line says START and follow next links to the page whose next line says END, collecting visited page ids in order. Near-miss lines (Next with a capital N, a space before the colon, or the word previous) are decoys and must be ignored. Two next lines name pages that do not exist: when a next page is missing, find the page whose exact prev line names your current page and continue from there. The walk never revisits a page. Use only the active tools for filesystem access. Finish with exactly one line with the exact form EVAL_RESULT {"pages":[...],"count":N} with N an integer. Any other final line format is a failure.
